title: gendered language in telephone conversations: a corpus-based study of lexical, grammatical, and pragmatic variation
core_idea: To investigate gender-related patterns in spoken American English by analyzing lexical, grammatical, and pragmatic variation in spontaneous telephone conversations using a variationist, corpus-based quantitative approach applied to the Switchboard Dialogue Act Corpus.
tldr: Corpus-based, variationist study aiming to identify how gender correlates with lexical, grammatical, and pragmatic variation in spontaneous telephone conversations (Switchboard), using quantitative analysis of spoken American English.
